headline: Approved voter registration applications and removed voters from the checklist, each by a 3-0 vote.
summary: The meeting covered voter registration applications, changes to voter records, and voter removals. Members accepted the applications and removed voters by 3-0 votes.
decisions: Removed voters who registered in another town or city, are no longer eligible to vote in Derry, or were removed for other reasons, 3-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Additions and Changes to the Checklist: The Supervisors of the Checklist considered applications for registrations by voters. Motion to accept by Supervisor Messina. Seconded by Supervisor Dombroski. Motion passed 3-0.

Voters Removed: The Supervisors of the Checklist considered removals by voters now registered in another town or city ward in New Hampshire, no longer eligible to vote in Derry, or removed for other reasons indicated. Motion to remove by Supervisor Dombroski. Seconded by Supervisor Strakalaitis. Motion passed 3-0.

decision_titles: Removal of voters from the checklist
